      Purchase options and add-ons

      • WATERISTANT MATERIAL: Made from fine-quality PVC water-resistant material, this raincoat is ideal for heavy rain. The material is durable, lightweight, and easy to clean, ensuring a long-lasting and practical solution for your rainy-day needs.
      • HOODED DESIGN: This raincoat features a hooded design that provides full coverage from the rain. The drawstring on the hood allows you to adjust the fit for maximum protection and comfort.
      • DUAL POCKETS: This raincoat comes equipped with dual pockets, providing ample space to store your essentials. The pockets are designed to keep your belongings safe and dry even in wet conditions.
      • ZIP CLOSURE & DRAWSTRING HEM: The raincoat has a sturdy and durable zip closure that makes it easy to put on and take off. The drawstring hem allows the wearer to adjust the fit of the raincoat around their waist and hips, providing a snug fit that keeps the rain out.
      • STYLISH AND VERSATILE: This raincoat is both stylish and versatile, making it suitable for a wide range of occasions. Whether you're commuting to work, running errands, or heading out for a hike, this raincoat has got you covered.

      Product Description

      Kinder Universal Raincoat (White)

      Product Features

      Stay dry, stay stylish

      When it comes to rainy days, it's easy to feel like fashion has to take a backseat to practicality. But with our stylish raincoats, you can have the best of both worlds. Our rainwear is designed to keep you dry and protected from the elements, while also making a statement.

      Versatility at its best

      Our raincoats offer versatility at their best, providing you with a garment that can be worn in various weather conditions and occasions. From lightweight and packable designs ideal for outdoor adventures to stylish and waterproof jackets that can be dressed up or down.

      • Are the rain jacket and trousers waterproof?

        Yes, our rain jacket and trousers are waterproof, providing you with maximum protection from rain and wet weather.

      • Can the raincoat be worn in cold weather?

        While the raincoats is designed to protect you from rain, they may not provide enough insulation to keep you warm in extremely cold temperatures.

      • Are the rain jacket and trousers breathable?

        Yes, our rain jacket and trousers are designed with breathable materials that allow air to circulate, preventing overheating and moisture build-up inside the garment.

      About this Item

      • WATERISTANT MATERIAL: Made from fine-quality PVC water-resistant material, this raincoat is ideal for heavy rain. The material is durable, lightweight, and easy to clean, ensuring a long-lasting and practical solution for your rainy-day needs.
      • HOODED DESIGN: This raincoat features a hooded design that provides full coverage from the rain. The drawstring on the hood allows you to adjust the fit for maximum protection and comfort.
      • DUAL POCKETS: This raincoat comes equipped with dual pockets, providing ample space to store your essentials. The pockets are designed to keep your belongings safe and dry even in wet conditions.
      • ZIP CLOSURE & DRAWSTRING HEM: The raincoat has a sturdy and durable zip closure that makes it easy to put on and take off. The drawstring hem allows the wearer to adjust the fit of the raincoat around their waist and hips, providing a snug fit that keeps the rain out.
      • STYLISH AND VERSATILE: This raincoat is both stylish and versatile, making it suitable for a wide range of occasions. Whether you're commuting to work, running errands, or heading out for a hike, this raincoat has got you covered.
